TP53.description: DNA-binding domain, containing the great majority of recurrent pathogenic/somatic 'hotspot' codons (e.g. R175, G245, R248, R249, R273, R282)
TP53.source: Well-established TP53 DNA-binding-domain mutational hotspot region; consistent with the IARC TP53 database's recurrent-codon findings. Curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

RET.description: Cysteine-rich extracellular domain; MEN2A hotspot codons (C609, C611, C618, C620, C630, C634)
RET.source: Well-established RET MEN2A genotype-phenotype correlation. Curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

RET.description: Tyrosine kinase domain; M918T is the classic MEN2B hotspot codon

FGFR3.description: Transmembrane domain; G380R is the classic achondroplasia hotspot codon

KRAS.description: P-loop GTPase domain; G12/G13 are classic RAS-pathway mutational hotspot codons
